messages.subject: Re: BioGeoBears help
parts:
Also, this could be an issue:

> I’m currently running the snow leopard version of 3.1.1, but my OS is Mavericks 10.9.

...you might as well install the R 3.1.1 made for 10.9, it just takes a second, and the difference could cause package installation issues if CRAN guesses the wrong compiled binaries.

Cheers,
Nick



On Wed, Jul 30, 2014 at 12:16 PM, Jacob Berv <jsb...@cornell.edu> wrote:
Hi there,
I’m trying to get started with BioGeoBears and I can’t get R to install it - here’s the output I get when I try to start your tutorial. Any advice would be appreciated. Should I install an older version of R? I’m currently running the snow leopard version of 3.1.1, but my OS is Mavericks 10.9.

Best,
Jacob Berv
